listBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the published list artifacts (GitHub Pages directory containing meta.json).

checkIntervalHours.description: How often to check for a new list version. Default 12.

minDaysBetweenFullSync.description: Minimum days between full artifact downloads. Default 7.

blockSubframes.description: Also block embedded iframes from blocked domains. Default true.

allowDomains.description: District allowlist. Overrides the blocklist. Subdomains included.

extraBlockDomains.description: District-specific blocks on top of the published list.

allowClearLogs.description: Show a working Clear button on the report page. Default false.

allowExport.description: Allow CSV/JSON export from the report page. Default true.

supportContact.description: Email or phone shown on the block page for false-positive reports.

blockMessage.description: Custom message shown on the block page.
